admin.module.flights.label: Flight partners
admin.module.flights.summary: Configure partner clickouts, affiliate links and search tracking.
flights.meta_description: Enter your needs once, check Taiwan–Vietnam flights with authorized partners, and pay on the partner website.
flights.title: Find Taiwan – Vietnam flights with baggage and checkout clarity
flights.intro: Timeblock structures your request and routes you to partners that confirm the final price, booking, payment and after-sales support.
flights.trust.no_passport: No passport or card data collected
flights.trust.partner_checkout: Partners confirm price and issue tickets
flights.form.title: Enter details once
flights.form.notice: This MVP has no live-price API. Partners confirm price, availability, taxes and fees after clickout.
flights.results.partner_confirms: Search and payment are completed on the partner website.
flights.provider.description.trip: Multilingual flight search and partner checkout at Trip.com.
flights.provider.description.traveloka: A familiar Vietnamese option; route and payment availability are confirmed by the partner.
flights.provider.description.lion: Taiwan travel partner with Traditional Chinese service.
flights.provider.description.colatour: An additional Taiwan option for international itineraries.
flights.provider.description.ezfly: Local channel for ticket advice and VietJet Taiwan support.
flights.disclosure.title: Link transparency
flights.disclosure.body: Timeblock is a discovery and referral platform. Some links may be affiliate links and Timeblock may earn commission on eligible bookings at no extra cost to you. The partner owns price, payment, ticketing, changes, refunds and support.
flights.guide.title: Six checks before booking
flights.guide.intro: Timeblock adds original guidance for the costs and risks that matter to Vietnamese travelers in Taiwan.
flights.guide.total_price.title: Check the total price
flights.guide.total_price.body: Compare final totals including taxes, surcharges and payment fees.
flights.guide.baggage.title: Confirm every baggage allowance
flights.guide.baggage.body: Check cabin and checked baggage for each segment, especially on low-cost or mixed-airline trips.
flights.guide.flexible_dates.title: Compare nearby dates
flights.guide.flexible_dates.body: If flexible, check one to three days on either side for a better total cost.
flights.guide.self_transfer.title: Self-transfer warning
flights.guide.self_transfer.body: Separate tickets may require baggage reclaim, immigration and accepting missed-connection risk.
flights.guide.support.title: Choose the right support
flights.guide.support.body: Prefer a partner with language and service channels that work for customers in Taiwan.
flights.guide.after_sales.title: Read change and refund rules
flights.guide.after_sales.body: Verify fees, deadlines, no-show rules and who handles schedule changes.
flights.audience.title: Built for Vietnamese communities in Taiwan
flights.audience.intro: Each group has different priorities. Timeblock stores search criteria, not travel documents.
flights.audience.student.title: Students
flights.audience.student.body: Flexible dates, low total cost and suitable baggage for longer breaks.
flights.audience.worker.title: Vietnamese workers
flights.audience.worker.body: Simple flows, transparent totals and Taiwan-based support options.
flights.audience.family.title: Vietnamese–Taiwanese families
flights.audience.family.body: Children, infants, seats, baggage and schedule-change terms matter most.
flights.admin.title: Flight partners
flights.admin.intro: Enable partners and add approved affiliate URLs. Never put API keys or passwords in a URL.
flights.admin.security_note: Only HTTPS URLs on allowlisted partner domains are accepted. Tracking IDs contain no email, phone number or account ID.
flights.error.route: Choose a valid route between Taiwan and Vietnam.
flights.error.provider_url: Affiliate URLs must use HTTPS and an approved partner domain.
